newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK - BOURSE AT RECORD HIGH.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK - BOURSE AT RECORD HIGH.

text.p: The market surged through the
500 mark over the week for the first time with the domestic
index rising 10.33 points to close at 501.65.
Barclays closed 55 thebe up at 830 thebe; food and
tobacco wholesaler Metsef gained 15 thebe to 675;
variable loan stock counter RDC Properties edged
slightly higher and finished two thebe up at 180; brewery
holding company Sechaba gained five thebe to 400.
Security group Inco fell five thebe to 1O5.
Trading unchanged was oil company Engen at 450
thebe.
Domestic turnover this week was slightly up, but value
traded was well down; with 487,700 shares changing hands versus
449,952 shares the previous week.
On the foreign board, two stocks traded higher over the
week. De Beers added 136 thebe to 13,119. McCarthy
Retail put on 54 thebe to 1,021.
Car rental and fleet management group Avis shed a
thebe to 678. Undervalued assets fund Regent was
unchanged at 4,000 thebe.
Newcomer professional services group Forbes
closed at 682 thebe.
